scope: Server MVP soak: residual Lasm memory growth after the host-RPC and send-borrow fixes (Linux x64, local, resource guard). Maintainer experiments; product fix awaiting review.
method: scripts as recorded in .work/residual (driver: N keep-alive clients against integration/fixtures/server-robustness; external /proc sampling; in-process diagnostic: process.memoryUsage, glibc mallinfo2 over all arenas, Worker#getHeapStatistics for every pthread isolate, smaps mapping census; glibc heap walk of in-use chunk sizes via /proc/PID/mem from the parent process)

rootCause.summary: Std.Http formats a Date header for every response; on Linux/macOS Std.Time reads /etc/localtime each time (host ops: getenv TZ, 2x stat, open, 2x read, close). Lasm routes these through src/native-file-worker-pool.mjs, which kept at most 2 idle workers and retired them after 1 s, so many file operations created and terminated a worker_threads Worker. Koffi 3.3.0 does not release its per-isolate FFI memory when a worker exits: each create/terminate leaked ~50-100 KiB of RSS and one 2 or 4 MiB anonymous mapping. Windows reads its time zone through op 180 (no file IO), which is why Windows was flat.

evidence.microFileChurn_HEAD: 16,000 open/read/read/close at concurrency 8 (src/native-files.mjs, no Lean): RSS 53->598 MiB, mappings 158->12,436

workerChurn500.plainWorker: RSS 62->69 MiB over 400 workers, mappings flat
workerChurn500.koffiFuncDefined: one 2 or 4 MiB mapping leaked per worker (mappings 141->476 for 300 workers)
workerChurn500.koffiSmallConfig: sync_stack/heap 64 KiB: many small mappings still leaked

evidence.starvedWorkersControl: 4 plain workers that never return to their event loop exchanging 19M messages: malloc in-use flat (rules out generic starved-isolate messaging)

fix.change: retain up to 16 idle workers (unref'd) for the host's life; no 1 s idle retirement
fix.test: test/native-file-worker-churn.test.mjs (fails on HEAD: idle workers recreated after a pause; passes with the fix)

safety.exitWith8IdleWorkers: process exits by itself in 0.16 s, status 0
safety.8x2000Cycles: 0 new workers; fds 62 and threads 15 unchanged
safety.concurrency32: creates workers beyond 16 and retires them: +16 workers per 32-wide burst (churn returns above the cap); fds 62->102 and threads 15->23 with 16 idle workers, then stable

afterFix.remaining: ~200-350 B/request on Linux, linear over 60 min / 1.0M requests (no plateau). >=94% of malloc growth is 65,616-byte chunks (~1 per 300-350 requests) holding V8 tagged heap pointers; more of them with --no-incremental-marking (391 B/req vs 191-293). Mapping count flat (96). Cause not identified.

koffiUpstream: No koffi changelog entry (through 3.3.3, 2026-10-10) mentions worker exit or per-worker memory release; 3.3.2 changed the default sync stack/heap sizes only. Not upgraded.
